notes: The retiring construction discounted each strategic initiative to a present value and added it to a price. An initiative could therefore never cost anything: the capital it consumes, the depreciation it creates, the working capital it ties up and the tax it pays all collapsed into one positive number. L3 through L6 of PROFORMA-SPEC replace that. The same initiative now emits revenue, cost, capex, depreciation and working capital in each period, and those lines are consolidated, taxed and depreciated exactly like the base business.
